notes: Tutor opening screen, cleaned up. The three ways to start a session now sit in the middle of the screen instead of hanging off the top, so it is obvious they are the point of the screen. The "Teach me in English" switch has its own panel and a line saying what it does, so it no longer reads as a heading for the buttons under it, and tapping anywhere on that panel flips it. With it on, the message box now asks you in English to write something in the language you are studying, instead of asking in the one language you cannot yet read.
